{{Quote|Protas, meet me in battle, and we shall decide who is the ruler of this blue kingdom.|Melkorr, "The Tale of the Aiwha Pod"|<ref name="tale" />}}
According to [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod|legend]], '''Melkorr''' was a dark titan from the depths of the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], with sharp pointed [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and large, pointed fins. He challenged the [[Deity/Legends|god-beast]] [[Protas]] for rule over the seas of Kamino and the two met in [[Battle of Thalina|battle]] at the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] ridge of [[Thalina]]. After fighting for six [[Standard day/Legends|days]] and six nights, Protas, using his speed and agility to outmaneuvre Melkorr's great power and size, emerged victorious, having [[Death/Legends|slayed]] the exhausted titan. Melkorr's [[Blood/Legends|blood]] spilt, his immense carcass fed the [[Fish/Legends|fish]] of the oceans for an [[Time/Legends|eon]]. Protas thus consolidated his power and continued to rule Kamino's oceans until he fell victim to both his arrogance and an [[Unidentified aiwha pod|aiwha pod]] who fought for their very survival. Melkorr and Protas' battle would be recounted in ''[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod]]'', which would eventually be translated into the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] language by [[Ryan Kaufman]].<ref name="tale" />

==Behind the scenes==
Melkorr appeared in the [[List of short stories|short story]] "[[The Tale of the Aiwha Pod (short story)]]," written by [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and published in the [[2005]] ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando: Prima Official Game Guide]]''.<ref name="tale" />
